meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会一直盯着某个 PR:反复轮询 CI 检查、新评论和未解决的 review 线程,把真实问题改掉并提交推送,直到检查通过、没有可执行评论为止。
howto.when: 当你要求 babysit 或持续监控某个 PR,直到它的评论、review 和 CI 问题全部解决时接管。

say.text: 帮我 babysit 这个 PR,盯到可以合并为止
say.note: 它会轮询检查、评论和 review 线程

say.text: 这个 PR 还有哪些 review 线程没解决?
say.note: 列出未解决线程及对应文件和行号

say.text: 把挂掉的 CI 修好推上去,然后接着盯
say.note: 修复后提交推送并回到轮询

howto.what_en: Claude keeps watching a pull request: polls checks, reads new comments and unresolved review threads, fixes real issues in focused commits, pushes, and repeats until checks pass and no actionable threads remain.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask Claude to babysit or keep monitoring a PR until its comments, reviews, and CI issues are all resolved.

say_en.text: Babysit this PR and don't stop until it's ready to merge.
say_en.note: Polls checks, comments, and review threads

say_en.text: Which review threads on this PR are still unresolved?
say_en.note: Lists unresolved threads with file and line

say_en.text: Fix the failing CI, push it, then keep watching.
